primary_questions: Why do temporal stability and q95 turnover fail in the early structural block?
Why does 000016.SH drive Block-B interaction from improvement to approximately -11 percent?

rolling_regime_panel.purpose: measure whether frozen-candidate gate failures and per-carrier temporal ratios change materially across time blocks

carrier_composition_panel.procedure: recompute only the 000016 common-scale target four times, each time omitting one of its four peers; all windows and anchored-partial controls remain frozen
carrier_composition_panel.strong_composition_attribution_if: at least two jackknife variants reduce 000016 monthly-ratio by >=25% versus baseline and reduce it to <=1.50

common_estimator_panel.counterfactual: replace peer cross-sectional median with peer cross-sectional mean only; keep common/carrier windows and anchored-partial state machine unchanged
common_estimator_panel.strong_estimator_attribution_if: both providers reduce 000016 monthly-ratio by >=25% and global interaction reduction changes from negative to nonnegative

clock_panel.rule: direct clock attribution requires the same carrier and evaluation window under an alternate 60m clock
